title: School Crossing Guard
description: Use to request a school crossing guard or report a crossing guard not at their post. Also use to report complaints, compliments and concerns related to school crossing guards, i.e., employee conduct, safety issues, information about the program, etc. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a crossing guard or to report a crossing-guard concern.
actions.why: For requesting a school crossing guard, reporting a guard absent from the post, or reporting a compliment, complaint, employee-conduct issue, safety concern, or question about the crossing-guard program.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "School Crossing Guard"
